create_NotInThisPartition: create a NotInThisPartition sentinel object to identify subtrees removed by partition
combine_partitions: combine multiple partitioned PyTrees by replacing NotInThisPartition sentinels with concrete values
combine_empty_partitions: combine zero partitions to return a NotInThisPartition sentinel as the identity
combine_incompatible_partitions: combine partitions with incompatible PyTree structures to raise a ValueError
combine_pairwise_subtrees: combine two PyTree subtrees pairwise, replacing NotInThisPartition with actual leaves
